name: Public Spring AI Azure chat YAML application

assertions: nested YAML Azure OpenAI properties produce one Foundry chat binding
the generated service target preserves application port 8081
Container App receives the API key only through a secret reference
generated files and local azd state do not disclose the API key
Foundry network access defaults to deny and allows only Container Apps outbound IPs
POST /api/chat returns HTTP 200 with a non-empty JSON message
all disposable Azure resources are deleted
